cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your bow at the ceremony was adequate. Mine follows the founder's original diagram.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The founder asked us to wave instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. His original diagram is in the constitution. My bow follows that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you have a signed exception. I'll bow on behalf of everyone still governed by the constitution.

mechanism: A assumes the power to judge legitimacy and subordinates B practical or founder-backed method to the supposedly superior authority of A own document.
confusable: Generic status boasting is confusable: each B suggestion must provoke an actual comparison of legitimacy and a new reason A method outranks it.
comparison: Picnic logistics become an appendix under A committee rota; ceremony instructions become a signed exception beneath A constitutional bow.
seedUse: Both exact cards and all four canonical seeds read. Preserve B practical success and signed evidence; A comparative ruling must respond to those contributions.
